title: HyperX’s new Cloud Alpha Air is its first open-back gaming headset.
summary: HyperX is announcing a slew of new gaming accessories for its Level Awakening livestream event — most notable is the $149.99 Cloud Alpha Air, due out in September. The open-back headset allows users to stay more in-tune with their surroundings while gaming.
